name: fast-laya-compaction
description: Verbatim Laya-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions, scored by a local Laya model (no API cost).

baseUrl.title: Laya server URL
baseUrl.description: URL of the local Laya scoring server. Leave unset to use LAYA_URL or http://127.0.0.1:8756/predict.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Tool calls and results scoring below this Laya probability are always removed; the cut rises above it until the target reduction is met.

targetReduction.title: Target reduction
targetReduction.description: Share of the transcript's characters to remove, dropping the lowest-scored tool calls and results first (Laya's absolute probabilities bunch in 0.5-0.9, only its ranking is informative). 0 uses the keep threshold as a fixed cut.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

stateMode.title: State mode
stateMode.description: local: one small state per tool call, fitted to Laya's window (default). whole: the whole conversation as one shared state; only for a 32k-class judge or RoPE-extended Laya.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: Laya requests in flight at once in local mode.

rules.title: Mechanical staleness rules
rules.description: Truncate, without asking Laya, the output of a call that an identical later call or a later Edit/Write of the same file made stale.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Laya state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated-token budget for one state (per call in local mode). Laya truncates each request at 1024 real tokens and counts ~1.5-1.75x the estimate on code, so keep this near 500.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Laya request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated-token budget for state plus questions in one Laya request; ~620 estimated is ~1000 real. Run `npm run calibrate` to re-measure.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Laya decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.
